name: JoAi: Create Automation

description.en: Create a contact journey (wait → warp → branch → halt). Triggers on prop, segment, webhook, or manual — not tags. Requires the Automations native app. Separate from oneshot campaigns.
description.de: Erstellt eine Kontakt-Journey (wait → warp → branch → halt). Trigger über Prop, Segment, Webhook oder manuell — keine Tags. Benötigt die Automations-App. Getrennt von einmaligen Kampagnen.
description.fr: Crée un parcours contact (wait → warp → branch → halt). Déclenché par prop, segment, webhook ou manuel — pas de tags. Nécessite l'app Automations. Distincte des campagnes ponctuelles.
description.es: Crea un recorrido de contacto (wait → warp → branch → halt). Se dispara por prop, segmento, webhook o manual — no por tags. Requiere la app Automations. Separada de las campañas puntuales.
description.it: Crea un percorso contatto (wait → warp → branch → halt). Si attiva su prop, segmento, webhook o manuale — non su tag. Richiede l'app Automations. Separata dalle campagne one-shot.
description.ro: Creează o călătorie de contact (wait → warp → branch → halt). Declanșată de prop, segment, webhook sau manual — nu de tag-uri. Necesită app-ul Automations. Separată de campaniile one-shot.

bot: Use for delayed welcome/drip journeys. Prefer prop onboarding-stage=done. Actions: wait | warp | branch | halt. Contact messages: warpId joai-contact-message-send with Hook-style inputs. Campaigns remain for newsletters/backfill. Requires Automations native app. enabled: pass 1 or 0.

inputs.name: Trigger type
inputs.bot: prop (contact property), segment, manual (run_automation only), or webhook (inbound Hook enroll).

inputs.name: Trigger config
inputs.bot: For prop: {"propKey":"onboarding-stage","propValue":"done"}. For segment: {"segmentId":"…"}. For webhook: {"source":"stripe"} (inbound Hook source query param).

inputs.name: Actions
inputs.bot: Ordered JSON. Types: wait {delayMinutes}, warp {warpId, inputs}, branch {when[], thenPosition, elsePosition}, halt {}. Example contact message: {"type":"warp","config":{"warpId":"joai-contact-message-send","inputs":{"contactId":{"source":"contact","path":"contact.id"},"message":{"source":"literal","value":"Hallo {{name}}"},"subject":{"source":"literal","value":"Hi"},"integration":{"source":"literal","value":"email"},"recipientId":{"source":"contact","path":"contact.email"}}}}. Wait uses delayMinutes only (0 = immediate). Multiple warps allowed.

inputs.name: Agent ID
inputs.bot: Agent UUID. Required for webhook triggers and when warps need a sending agent (e.g. joai-contact-message-send). The agent must have the channel configured. There is no team-wide fallback.

error.fr: Échec de la création de l'automatisation : {{MESSAGE}}
error.es: No se pudo crear la automatización: {{MESSAGE}}
